test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some T are M.

II. No T is Y.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some M are not Y.

II. Some M are T.

III. All M are Y.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e8673101b81a219f525beae69f7b345dd582b3f08a2d4e66e7afc35c02c8282.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some M are not Y → True (As Some T are M and No T is Y so, Some M are not Y is definitely true)

II. Some M are T → True (As Some T are M so, Some M are T is true)

III. All M are Y → False (As Some T are M and No T is Y so, All M are Y is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follows".**
